warnings: B5 follows the same 'constant main + curtailed additional bar' pattern as B4/B10A on หน้า24 — constant 3-DB12 top/bottom, plus a 2-DB16 bar that sits top-at-support and bottom-at-midspan.

B6/B6A each print FOUR distinct rebar lines per section (e.g. B6 SECTION_1-1 top: '3-DB12' then '2-DB16'; bottom: '2-DB16' then '2-DB12') — modelled as a constant 2-DB16 on both top and bottom faces (present identically in both sections) plus an additional 3-DB12/2-DB12 bar that curtails/switches face between the two sections, mirroring the B4/B10A/B5 judgement call on this house.

B3' shows only ONE section (no SECTION_2-2) with an asymmetric top (2-DB12 + 1-DB16) vs bottom (2-DB12 only) — read as a short cantilever/negative-moment beam (consistent with its 0.70m offset dimension on the LONG SECTION view, unlike B1' which starts flush at 0), not a curtailment pair, so no 'at support/at midspan' note was added.
